items.text: Resolve the reported team routing test failures and rerun the test suite
Read the attached screenshots to see which pages/labels break
Audit renderer styles for text that cannot wrap (nowrap, min-width, fixed widths)
Fix the wrapping problems across the app pages
Verify: layout checks + relevant tests + lint
Commit and push the verified changes
Run the dependency install (npm install) after the work is done, as asked
